greeting.text: Bring Human civic care into the maze without imposing a single voice. Our capital is Awshoshotra. Its principal will register this work after the local balance. The outlying witness is at Showammig (1420, 540).

choices.text: Bring Human civic care into the maze without imposing a single voice.

actions.value: Keep the wisdom obligation; publish revisions honestly.

hint:mission:greek:wisdom.text: Bring Human civic care into the maze without imposing a single voice. Inspect Showammig at 1420, 540, listen to the visiting witness, and repair the circuit beside Greek Horde Mediator. Inspect the independent reading at Showammig. Listen to the Humans witness. Record a testable commitment with the circuit keeper. Restore the regional circuit.
